architectural-decision-records.why: records the genesis/reconcile generator decision and its limits
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0047: esk-genesis reads the upstream manifest, copies gates+machinery+tests into a consumer (hash-verified), preserves repo-local gates, removes dropped gates on reconcile, scaffolds the required-check workflow with the right env; states the consumer-CI ceiling
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the generator ships a discrimination test proven to fail when its copy step is neutralized
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added esk-genesis.mjs + a 14-case fixture test (fresh genesis, byte-identical copies, repo-local preservation, reconcile removal, idempotency, source-integrity blocker, path-traversal block, injection-name block, workflow-env assertion, repo-local no-test warning, dry-run, fail-closed); neutralizing the copy step OR either containment guard turns a test red
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code (.mjs), so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: a fixture-driven test that builds a synthetic upstream and runs the real generator into a throwaway target is the right level for a file-generating tool; verified end-to-end that the generated consumer passes the aggregator
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added .mjs; the behavior is committed as Gherkin
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements the genesis and version-updates features (reconcile leaves repo-local untouched, machinery present, a dropped gate leaves no orphan) with a discrimination test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the generator copies and installs executable gate scripts into another repo
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: every gate/machinery SCRIPT copy is hash-verified against the manifest (missing/non-string sha256 is a blocker; tests are copy-verified, not manifest-hashed); every destination is contained to the target (no path traversal); the upstream repo name is constrained to owner/repo before being written into the scaffolded workflow; writes nothing without --yes and rolls back newly-created files on a mid-apply failure
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limits rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that enforcement is live only once an admin makes the check required, that repo-local gates need a test added, that the workflow is not force-overwritten, and that provenance stays red until the upstream asset is published
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

release-deployment-safety.why: a code generator that installs CI gate files; it scaffolds a workflow but deploys, migrates, and releases nothing itself

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: will run a fresh-context judge-arch review over the generator, its test, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a CI bootstrapping tool; no application system, data store, or resilience architecture built

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a plan-then-apply file generator

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

arch-encode.why: planned enforcement machinery, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
